phrases.phrase: Presidential Unit Citation rows are managed automatically. Every milpac holds one for each of the regiment's Presidential Unit Citations, linked to its certificate, so they can't be added, edited or deleted here.

The position the add-milpac form starts on. Defaults to 193 (New Recruit). On a roster that does not list this position the form is left unset, and the recruiter can change it on any roster before saving. Set this if a vendor rebuild renumbers the positions.
The rank the add-milpac form starts on. Defaults to 23 (Recruit). The recruiter can still pick a different rank before saving. Set this if a vendor rebuild renumbers the ranks.

Keeps one PUC row per live regiment grant on every milpac: on a new milpac, when a regiment grant is issued, corrected or withdrawn, and daily. With it on, the award forms refuse to add, edit or delete a PUC row. Off until the cav7-enlistment-defaults:puc-strip command has run, which turns it on.
The service record type used for the first record written on a new milpac. Defaults to the Transfer type. Set this if a vendor rebuild renumbers the record types.

The user a PUC row is attributed to when no member is acting: on a milpac created from the CLI, and on every row the strip or the PUC sync job writes. A milpac created by a member attributes its rows to them.
Settings for the 7Cav enlistment defaults companion add-on, which writes a new milpac's first service record and keeps one PUC row per regiment grant on every milpac.
